title: HIDIVE Confirms 2027 Release for Major Isekai Movie Return After 4 Years – Watch New Trailer
content: There’s a major Isekai anime franchise coming back with a new movie next year after four years of waiting, and HIDIVE has now confirmed it will be overseeing its release outside of Japan with a new trailer and poster to help show it off.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Free Fire Daybreak' Unveils Main Cast, Fourth Promo
content: The Free Fire World Series Global Finals 2026 event revealed the main cast and a fourth promotional video for the television anime Free Fire Daybreak on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Natsune Inui Joins Cast of #I'm Looking For a Zombie Anime
content: Kadokawa revealed a new cast member on Sunday for the television anime of Katsuwo 's #I’m Looking For a Zombie ( #Zombie Sagashitemasu ) manga. Natsune Inui joins the cast as Zomko, a zombie the main characters meet on their journey who does not attack people and who is bad at communicating.
author: ANN

title: Texas' Anime Frontier to Screen World Premiere of Maiden Blood Anime
content: The premiere will screen in Room 202CD. Anime Frontier will run from December 4 to December 6 in Fort Worth, Texas. Maiden Blood will debut in 2027. The dark fantasy action anime will star Iori Saeki as Eva and Yukari Anzai as Epica.
author: ANN

title: Naver Webtoon's Cuts Make App Wins Google Play's Best App of the Year Award for 2026 in S. Korea
content: Naver WEBTOON announced on November 18 its short-form video creation app Cuts Make, which allows users to create derivative content based on webtoon intellectual properties (IP), has been named Best App of the Year in Google Play 's Best of 2026 awards in South Korea.
author: ANN

title: Temppal: Overgeared PC, Mobile Game Debuts in Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau
content: Korean game developer and publisher NEXON released TEMPPAL : OVERGEARED , a new full-3D MMORPG based on the popular Korean fantasy web novel and webtoon Overgeared , in Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau on November 26. Developed by GRAYGAMES and published by NEXON Korea, the game is available on PC and mobile.
author: ANN

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Unveils New Visual, Trailer, Theme Song Artists
content: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 unveiled a new visual and trailer along with the theme song artists on Saturday. performs The opening theme song “Mechachu!!” will be sung by HIMEHINA while the ending theme song “Hatsukoi no Distortion” is performed by Straight Angeli.
author: Anime Corner

title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Unveils Teaser Trailer
content: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime unveiled a teaser trailer on Saturday. The anime is set to premiere in 2027 with studio feel. animating the series. The anime stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka. A visual was released last month.
author: Anime Corner

title: Singer LiSA and Voice Actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki Announce Divorce
content: Singer LiSA and voice actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki announced on Saturday that they have divorced after nearly seven years of marriage. The announcements were made through separate statements on their respective official websites.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Korea's EBS TV Network to Premiere 5 Generative AI-Assisted Animated Series in December
content: South Korea's public educational broadcaster Educational Broadcasting System (EBS) will premiere five animated series created using generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology, beginning December 1. The series were selected through the broadcaster's 2026 Generative AI Animation Series Co-Production Project.
author: ANN
